Among landable segments, ppt-web-ui and ppt-web-core were already reviewed earlier today (2026-09-03 signals on disk), so selected the oldest-unreviewed LANDABLE segment not yet touched today: reality-web (2026-08-29).

signals.evidence: frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/realtor/[id]/page.tsx:16-20 — the public agent-profile route renders MOCK_AGENT / MOCK_AGENT_LISTINGS / MOCK_AGENT_REVIEWS imported from ./_mock and NEVER reads the [id] route param nor calls the reality-server API. Every /[locale]/realtor/<any-id> URL renders the same hardcoded mock agent, listings and reviews (147-line _mock.ts). Additionally the contact form's handleSendMessage (page.tsx:22-28, wired to <form onSubmit> at :591) is a no-op that only sets messageSent=true and closes the drawer — it never POSTs the inquiry to any endpoint, so realtor contact requests are silently dropped. Contrast: sibling app/[locale]/listings/[slug]/page.tsx and account/listings/[id]/edit/page.tsx are correctly wired (fetch by slug/id, response.ok checks, notFound(), getMyListing/updateListing from @/lib/realtor-api). Shipped-looking public route backed entirely by mocks with a dead contact action.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/profile/page.tsx:17,65,268,346,384 — the signed-in user's own profile route renders MOCK_PROFILE / MOCK_LISTINGS / MOCK_ACTIVITY / MOCK_REVIEWS from ./_mock instead of the authenticated user's real data; the file's own header comment (lines 8-11) acknowledges 'when [auth] lands, replace MOCK_* with live data via the SDK'. The page ships showing placeholder identity, listings, activity and reviews to every logged-in user. Completeness stub — should fetch via the reality-api-client once the auth/session wiring is available.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/realtor/[id]/page.tsx hardcodes Slovak-only UI strings — ':114 "✓ Overený maklér" (verified-realtor badge), :227 "Aktívne ponuky (...)", :330 "Hodnotenia (...)" — bypassing next-intl useTranslations()/getTranslations() despite reality-web shipping sk/cs/de/en (per app CLAUDE.md and messages/*.json). cs/de/en visitors to any agent profile see Slovak. The page carries a data-i18n="pages.agent-profile.root" marker (:32) but the visible copy is never routed through the message catalog. i18n localization defect on a public route.
